principle: Minimal sufficient context. A cold-start agent loads only what the current action needs: a bounded startup set, then on-demand retrieval by exact ID/path/hash. Restricted classes require explicit authority; forbidden classes are never loaded into model context at all.
on_demand: the current work capsule for the active ticket
an exact evidence pointer by id/path/hash
one extra hop from an exact reference

reporting.style: Concise. Minimal sufficient context applies to what a seat emits, not only what it loads: report findings, not narration.
must: lead with the verdict or result
quote check output verbatim, and name the exact command that produced it
state blockers, unknowns and unrecoverable evidence explicitly - 'nothing survives here' is a finding
reference tickets, paths and hashes exactly
must_not: restate the brief or narrate steps already taken
pad with preamble, summary of the summary, or speculative next steps
claim a check passed that was not run
invent findings or backlog content to appear productive

rules.startup_bounded: startup has at most max_startup_items entries.
rules.no_forbidden_preload: No forbidden class may appear in startup or on_demand.
rules.retrieval_order: Retrieve by exact ID/path/hash first, keyword second, semantic fallback last; never recursively read all linked material; default maximum is one extra hop.
